queries_run: Netflix generative AI video threat substitute YouTube short-form AI-generated content 2026

findings.claim: Netflix 10-K 風險因素：娛樂影音有訂閱、廣告、盜版等多種模式可能搶走市場，且含生成式 AI 在內的新技術快速演進
findings.excerpt: New entrants may enter the market or existing providers may adjust their services with unique offerings or approaches to providing entertainment video. In addition, new technological developments, including the development and use of generative AI, are rapidly evolving.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：Netflix 成立 INKubator 生成式 AI 短內容動畫工作室，並推手機垂直影片動態，對標 YouTube／短影音平台
